decisions.name: Canonical CPQ and ZIP ownership
decisions.rationale: 19-item CODE_PURPLE_BD_QUEUE_v1 remains owner ledger; #530 ZIP verifier, #531 breadth producer and #533 lane viewer remain separate; no new SSOT.

decisions.name: Observed merge not admitted
decisions.rationale: Hub #724 and CODEX #1097 merged with no observed independent reviews; default branch protection and effective rule evidence unresolved, so no formal admission credit.

decisions.name: Private QPS segregated
decisions.rationale: Public handover omits QPS private SHA, commercial/engineering documents, ticket titles and telemetry until authorized owner returns a public-safe receipt.

decisions.name: Failure level annotations separate from annotated green
decisions.rationale: Successful CODEX checks can have multiple annotations; the count is not evidence of failure-level severity without authorized per-annotation readback.
